channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan Tobacco studies deal for Imperial Brands
item.description: Japan Tobacco has been considering teaming up with a partner on an acquisition of Imperial and then splitting up the British company's assets.

item.title: Japan firms say rate hikes are starting to bite, new study shows
item.description: Almost 59% of companies said the negative effects of higher rates are greater than the positive ones.

item.title: Japan’s insurers have ‘given up’ on yen with record-low hedging
item.description: Nine of the largest life insurers collectively hedged 43.3% of their foreign-asset holdings with derivatives in the six months ended Sept. 30.

item.title: Hawkish Bank of Japan member seeks quick rate hikes on inflation
item.description: "I believe that the bank needs to bring the policy rate to the neutral level soon," Naoki Tamura said in a speech to local business leaders.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
